review_scope: Static source-to-retail semantic review grounded in the 16-property structural comparison (docs/fidelity/evidence/0x004D14E0-structural-comparison.json), the Binary Ninja disassembly, radare2 CFG, angr CFGFast at the exact entry, and the rebuilt candidate object. No runtime, memory-observation or rendered/culling comparison exists, so the review covers transcribed operations, arguments, memory layout, calls/side effects, return and fatal paths, and floating-point sites; it does not establish behavioral or bit-exact equivalence.

checks.rationale: Retail entry 0x004D14E0, extent 0x004D14E0..0x004D2534 (4181 bytes), 1114 instructions, 146 blocks / 228 edges, one return. Binary Ninja and radare2 node/edge sets are identical (score 1.0); angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with 159 blocks / 245 edges and no unresolved jumps, the extra blocks being call-instruction splits. The only caller is Render_DrawLightmapMesh_4 at 0x004D2639, which pushes one 32-bit context and cleans 8 bytes. The candidate binds terraintraversal to the same VA through igi::retail::terrain and is included in the igi target (CMakeLists.txt:88); the earlier throwing placeholder in terrain_loaders.cpp has been removed. The linked executable body is the pre-fix revision, and the measured object is the corrected source.
checks.name: function_identity

checks.rationale: The ABI is cdecl with one 32-bit argument at [esp+4], an int32 EAX return and caller cleanup, derived from the single call site rather than from decompiler naming. The argument is the terrain/render context: LOD node pointers are read at context+0x10 + kLodSlotTable[k]*4 for slots {0,1,2,4,5}; the height cut-off is the f64 at context+0xDFC when context is non-null, otherwise 0xE0000000; camera-space anchors come from context+0xDE0/0xDE4/0xDE8. The candidate declares std::int32_t Terrain_TraverseContourQuadtree(void* context) and uses the same offsets.
checks.name: argument_mapping

checks.rationale: All constants are retail-derived: 0xE0000000 as the null-context height fallback; frame stamp = low 16 bits of 0x00C10380 with probe wrap 0x800; cache-empty stamp 0xFFFFFFFF; sector-extent constant 1.73210001f and 2^30 scale; corner table constant 0x40000000; detail/visibility threshold 9600; level mask 0x183; record limit 0xFFF; cache size 0x800; level cap 0x10; octant masks and the 0x40-byte node copies. The seven level+1 shift sites (centre_x/y/z, corner_z_level, half_extent, world_x, world_y) and the level-only sites (merge undo, post-increment corner advance) are transcribed at the exact shifts, and the rebuilt object reads one shared level+1 count for the four corrected shifts.
checks.name: constants_and_scaling

checks.rationale: The 0x1C-byte cache entry layout is reproduced: 16-bit stamp at +0x10 (the record's earlier wording uses the entry base, with data at +0x18 and the release type beside it), coordinate comparison for reuse, and the three release pools selected by allocation type. Traversal records are 0x30 bytes written in reverse from the cursor: +0x2C entry pointer, +0x28 token high, +0x24 token low|0xFFFF, +0x20 child category, +0x1C child id, +0x18 level+1, and +0x10/+0x08/+0x00 key_z/key_y/key_x as doubles. The five 0x40-byte LOD nodes are saved to 0x00A4EF38 and restored after traversal. The 0x20-byte child-record stride at 0x004D2052 versus the 0x40-byte node view remains unresolved; the review confirms the candidate reads the same fields at the same strides but does not claim the two views are one array. Allocation records +0x00..+0x2C and the octant masks are reproduced.
checks.name: memory_layout_and_access

checks.rationale: Retail has six instruction-level call sites: DynObj_ParseConfigFile_6 (0x004C5810 at 0x004D1579), the merge callback through [0x00A9CAE0 + category*4] at 0x004D1AE3, the split callback through [0x00A9C4E0 + category*4] at 0x004D1CAB, and three Debug_Error calls at 0x004D2425, 0x004D2434 and 0x004D252B. The callback contract (item pointer, [item+0x48], zero-extended category index, cdecl cleanup) and the per-item flag masks are reproduced. The callback targets are unresolved because both tables are zero in the file image; the review covers sites and arguments, not targets. The candidate's other side effects match: cache entry writes and three-pool reclaim, record/descriptor counters g_b16ca4/g_b16c9c, overflow counter g_b12b80, worklist state, and no allocation.
checks.name: calls_and_side_effects

checks.rationale: The function has exactly one retn, at the end of the eviction sweep, and returns the constant 0x800 cache-entry count. All earlier exits are fatal Debug_Error calls followed by a tight jmp $ (0x004D2425/0x004D242D, 0x004D2434/0x004D243C, 0x004D252B/0x004D2533); there is no error object or alternate success return. The candidate has one return of 0x800 and routes the three fatal messages through Error_Show (the same retail VA 0x004AF7B0) followed by halt_forever(). The no-return property of the retail Debug_Error callee is not statically proven, so the explicit halt is retained rather than assumed; the sites, message order and halt behaviour match.
checks.name: return_and_error_paths

checks.rationale: The reviewed scope is operation order, conversion points and scaling, not bit-exactness. The sector extent uses fpatan/fcos on the two saved angles in retail and std::atan/std::cos (double) in the candidate, with the same 1.73210001f and 2^30 expression and a float store. The height cut-off is an f64 load truncated to i32, with 0xE0000000 for a null context. Corner and shift arithmetic uses the same level+1 quantities; detail uses the same max-abs component and (level_shift+0x19)&0x1F. The candidate replaces x87 80-bit intermediates and FISTP truncation with double/libm and static_cast, so last-bit differences can flip boundary cull decisions; this is recorded as QT-D2 and is not claimed to be bit-identical.
checks.name: floating_point_semantics

limitations: No runtime capture, no memory observation and no rendered/culling comparison exists; RUNTIME_TESTED, VERIFIED and VERIFIED_WITH_DOCUMENTED_SCOPE are not claimed.

The measured candidate is the pre-link COFF object from source 26f2fa... (object bcd7070c...). build-clean-win32/igi1.exe contains the function at 0x00463080 with .text 0x20A0 but was linked before the QT-D1 correction, so its body is the pre-fix revision; relinking is outside this task.
cfg_similarity 1.0 is the retail Binary Ninja-vs-radare2 score only; the candidate comparison is source/object-level and is not a candidate-vs-retail jaccard.
The rebuilt object measures 1701 instructions / 169 blocks / 268 edges / 8384-byte .text versus retail 1114 / 146 / 228 / 4181; code size and block shape are not comparable across compilers.
The callback tables 0x00A9CAE0 and 0x00A9C4E0 are zero in the file image and are populated at runtime. Call targets are unresolved; only sites, category indexing, arguments and cleanup are reviewed.
The token read 0x00B97B1C is aliased to the bounded g_data_b97b20 array; out-of-contract indices substitute 0xFFFF where retail reads past the established object.
x87 80-bit intermediates are modelled with double and libm atan/cos; last-bit sector-extent differences can flip boundary cull decisions (QT-D2).
The candidate registers an SJLJ unwind frame that retail does not, adding two calls and an exception-chain write per invocation.

Worklist capacity 128 is retail's own array; the proved maximum live occupancy is 121 for the shared push block up to level 15. A level-16 entry through the unguarded mark path would read [child+0x30] through a null P[k] child, so that input is outside the proof.
P[] and worklist[0] are zero-initialised where retail leaves them uninitialised for null LOD slots or a null root; non-null live paths are unaffected.
The 0x20-byte child-record stride at 0x004D2052 versus the 0x40-byte node view remains an unresolved data-layout question; the compared properties and worklist proof do not depend on it.
The linked executable predates the source correction; no executable-level or runtime claim is made for the corrected revision.
No live behavioral runner exists for this translation unit, so the strict gate cannot pass on behavioral evidence.

status_rationale: Passed for the declared static scope. The 16-property structural comparison supports STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED at source/object level; it does not support BUILD_VERIFIED as a status increment, RUNTIME_TESTED, VERIFIED or any rendered/culling claim. The unresolved callback targets, x87 modelling, SJLJ frame, worklist premise and child-record layout are retained as explicit limitations.
